claims.quote: Nemacheilus saravacensis is a nemacheilid loach from Borneo, recorded from drainages in Sarawak (Malaysia) and West Kalimantan (Indonesia).
Nemacheilus saravacensis is a nemacheilid loach from Borneo, recorded from drainages in Sarawak (Malaysia) and West Kalimantan (Indonesia).
Native to the island of Borneo where it's been recorded from various drainages in the Malaysian state of Sarawak and neighbouring Indonesian province Kalimantan Barat (West Kalimantan).
